delete from patient_record where research_id = #{researchId} and patient_id = #{patientId} and follow_id = #{followId}
mapper.select: select r.follow_status, r.name,r.evaluate_status_back from patient_record r,patient_info p,research_info i,mp_person mp where i.id = p.research_id and p.patient_id = r.patient_id and mp.person_id = p.person_id and p.patient_activity_status = '1' and r.research_id = #{researchId} and r.is_submit= 1

select r.over_time_status,r.name,r.over_evaluate_status_back from patient_record r,patient_info p,research_info i,mp_person b ,patient_record_template prt where i.id = p.research_id and p.patient_id = r.patient_id and b.person_id = p.person_id and prt.follow_id=r.follow_id and prt.follow_num>0 and r.research_id = #{researchId}

select r.warn_status,r.name,r.warn_evaluate_status_back from patient_record r, patient_info p, research_info i, mp_person b where i.id = p.research_id and p.patient_id = r.patient_id and b.person_id = p.person_id and p.patient_activity_status = '1' and r.research_id = #{researchId}

select rd.disease_name, ri.project_name from patient_record pr left join patient_info pi on pr.patient_id = pi.patient_id left join research_info ri on pi.research_id = ri.id left join research_diseases rd on ri.disease_type_id = rd.disease_id where pr.research_id = #{researchId}
where patient_id = #{patientId} order by create_time asc limit 0,1
